title: Add settlement oracle policy readiness
summary: Settlement deployment readiness lists oracle policy as a human-owned blocker with no dedicated local evidence. Add a read-only oracle policy readiness report and validator that define source selection, update authority, staleness, manipulation, outage, and deployment-binding requirements without selecting a production oracle.
expectedFailureModes: Deployment readiness keeps reporting an oracle-policy blocker without concrete local evidence for what must be decided before on-chain release.
Docs imply production oracle readiness before a source, update authority, stale-data policy, manipulation controls, and outage behavior are selected and reviewed.
Autonomous agents cannot distinguish locally validated oracle policy scaffolding from human-owned oracle source and deployment decisions.
humanEscalation: Human approval remains required for production oracle source selection, update authority custody, and deployment binding.
nextAction: Add the settlement oracle policy readiness report, validator, docs, and deployment-readiness evidence while keeping production oracle selection human-owned.
